title: NeuroListen (Listening to the Brain): sEEG auditory-reconstruction features from 5 participants, authors' per-trial HGA/LFS/BBS arrays
description: This derivative dataset provides per-trial feature arrays from stereo-EEG recordings of five epilepsy patients passively listening to spoken Mandarin Chinese words, Mandarin digits and English words. Features include high-gamma activity, low-frequency signal and broadband representations at 200 Hz, normalised within 2 s windows after removal of epileptiform contacts and bipolar re-referencing. It supports research on neural decoding and auditory/speech reconstruction from intracranial signals.
methods_description: Five patients with epilepsy (native Mandarin speakers, ages 25-40) listened passively to 2 s spoken words (44 Mandarin words, 10 digits, 20 English words). sEEG was recorded with Sinovation SDE-10/12/16 shafts on a Nihon Kohden EEG-1200 at 1000 Hz, with stimulus markers sent to a DC channel. Contacts with epileptiform activity were removed, signals were bipolar re-referenced, and HGA (70-150 Hz), LFS (low-pass 100 Hz) and broadband features were computed at 200 Hz and normalised per 2 s window.
